name: McCloud
description: Deputy Marshal Sam McCloud of the small western town of Taos, New Mexico is assigned to the metropolitan New York City Police Department (NYPD) as a special investigator.

videos.title: The Return of Sam McCloud
videos.overview: Ex-Marshal McCloud now is senator of New Mexico, fighting for a new environment law. His enemy is Maitland, unscrupulous owner of Chemtel, the world's most important chemical manufacturer. Shortly after McCloud gives an inspiring speech, he barely escapes an bomb in his car and a shooting in a restaurant. When he learns that his niece, medical researcher for Chemtel, was killed, he begins to suspect that the attempts on his life were not made by Arabian terrorists, but by Maitland. He pays him a visit in Britain and starts to research on his own.

videos.title: Man from Taos
videos.overview: Re-edited for syndication from original episodes 1 and 6: "Who Says You Can't Make Friends in New York City" and "Our Man in Paris". McCloud goes to help a lady in distress in the room across from him at his hotel, but gets caught in a shootout that sends him back to Taos on Chief Clifford's orders. With the life of Chief Clifford on the line, McCloud travels to Paris, where he and a stewardess try to locate a mysterious arms smuggler.

videos.title: Manhattan Manhunt
videos.overview: Re-edited for syndication from original episodes 2 and 4: "Horse Stealing on Fifth Avenue" and "The Stage Is All the World". McCloud is becoming famous thanks to an article by Chris Coughlin in the Chronicle. It doesn't endear him to the boys in blue, who have to deal with a string of drugstore holdups. McCloud is assigned to protect a British theatrical maven who has received letters assailing his "filthy, obscene" productions and threatening his life.

videos.title: Murder Arena
videos.overview: Re-edited for syndication from original episodes 3 and 5: "The Concrete Corral" and "Walk in the Dark". McCloud is assigned to keep an eye on a boisterous bunch of rodeo riders at Madison Square Garden. He encounters an ex-girlfriend and a murder. Chief Clifford sends McCloud to the all female Special Auxiliary Force VI under the command of Sgt. Dameron, where he works to catch a murderer in Central Park.

videos.title: Portrait of a Dead Girl (or Who Killed Miss U.S.A.?)
videos.overview: McCloud escorts a witness from New Mexico to New York City, but loses him to kidnappers and finds himself in a murder case involving Puerto Rican nationalists, a lady novelist, a Wall Street lawyer, and a dead beauty pageant winner.

videos.title: Man from Taos (1) (or Who Says You Can't Make Friends in New York City?)
videos.overview: McCloud goes to help a lady in distress, but gets caught in a shootout that sends him back to Taos on Chief Clifford's orders. At the last minute, the Chief is kidnapped to force McCloud to act as a courier to Paris.

videos.title: Manhattan Manhunt (1) (or Horse Stealing on Fifth Avenue)
videos.overview: McCloud is becoming famous thanks to press coverage. It doesn't endear him to the boys in blue, who have to deal with a string of drugstore holdups.

videos.title: Murder Arena (1) (or The Concrete Corral)
videos.overview: McCloud is assigned to shepherd the cowboys at a visiting rodeo. They're old friends, and one of them is killed by a jealous rival over a woman, it appears.

videos.title: Manhattan Manhunt (2) (or The Stage Is All the World)
videos.overview: McCloud, whose new-found celebrity (thanks to an article by Chris Coughlin in the Chronicle) vexes the Department, is assigned to protect a British theatrical maven who has received letters assailing his ""filthy, obscene"" productions and threatening his life.

videos.title: Murder Arena (2) (or Walk in the Dark)
videos.overview: McCloud complains about his assignment to rodeo detail, so Chief Clifford sends him to Special Auxiliary Force VI under the command of Sgt. Dameron, where he works to catch a murderer in Central Park.

videos.title: Man from Taos (2) (or Our Man in Paris)
videos.overview: In Paris, McCloud and a stewardess try to locate a mysterious arms smuggler with ties to an American mogul and a New York gubernatorial candidate.

videos.title: Encounter with Aries
videos.overview: The wife of an astrologer and widely-syndicated newspaper columnist is kidnapped in broad daylight.

videos.title: Top of the World, Ma!
videos.overview: A football player from Ohio who needs an operation goes to find the New York mobster who owes him money.

videos.title: Somebody's Out to Get Jennie
videos.overview: An industrial engineer is thought to have been died in an air crash, and his secretary is driven into a mental hospital.

videos.title: The Disposal Man
videos.overview: A nabob is menaced by a professional killer with an unknown employer.

videos.title: A Little Plot at Tranquil Valley
videos.overview: Stolen penicillin is diluted and sent south of the border by the director of a famous cemetery.

videos.title: Fifth Man in a String Quartet
videos.overview: A musician is framed for the killing of his teacher, a violinist whose long-lost brother was in the mob.

videos.title: Give My Regrets to Broadway
videos.overview: A Broadway producer is implicated in the murder of a detective investigating his business practices.

videos.title: The New Mexican Connection
videos.overview: A TV commentator's critique of police shootings tarnishes the department's stakeout squad, and Chris Coughlin is threatened to force the release of a murder suspect extradited to Taos by McCloud.

videos.title: The Barefoot Stewardess Caper
videos.overview: A bevy of international stewardesses have a second career as cat burglars.

videos.title: The Park Avenue Rustlers
videos.overview: As part of a pilot program, McCloud is assigned a female partner, and the two go undercover against a big-time auto theft ring.

videos.title: Showdown at the End of the World
videos.overview: An ambitious junior executive in the mob uses fashion models to transport heroin into New York.

videos.title: The Million Dollar Round Up
videos.overview: A dying Roman mobster wills his ""Saracen Horse,"" a jewel-encrusted green jade treasure, to any of his criminal colleagues who can take possession of it.

videos.title: Butch Cassidy Rides Again
videos.overview: The NYPD demonstrates a bank robbery on live closed-circuit TV, and is bushwhacked by a gang of antiquated outlaws.

videos.title: The Solid Gold Swingers
videos.overview: While answering a high-rise apartment burglary call, McCloud stumbles on a body, which then disappears. The case leads to a VIP madam under indictment, whose girls are apparently being murdered by a serial killer.

videos.title: A Cowboy in Paradise
videos.overview: Just before presenting a rackets case, Chief Clifford goes to Hawaii for a police conference. Taos sends McCloud, too, and the Marshal is obliged to dragoon a vacationing N.Y. policewoman when the Chief is set up on a murder charge.

videos.title: The Colorado Cattle Caper
videos.overview: Modern-day cattle rustlers ship lethally contaminated beef to New York.

videos.title: This Must Be the Alamo
videos.overview: During a heat wave, Chief Clifford is called away and leaves Sgt. Broadhurst in charge. A football gambling ring that scores with ""inside dope on injuries"" loses a little black book and begins eliminating witnesses in a search for it, leading to an assault on precinct headquarters.

videos.title: The Barefoot Girls of Bleecker Street
videos.overview: McCloud helps a runaway and her baby, amidst a curious stolen property investigation.

videos.title: The Gang That Stole Manhattan
videos.overview: McCloud is assigned to a film shoot, and suspects the production is a front.

videos.title: Shivaree on Delancy Street
videos.overview: A black gang infiltrating a white ethnic gang's numbers racket makes four very big mistakes, in ascending order of importance: robbing and killing a pickup man for his bets and the numbers; shooting Broadhurst (knocking him out of the episode after the first scene) when he tries to interfere; framing the unconscious Broadhurst for skimming money from the numbers runners; and depriving a VERY well-connected Jewish tailor of his winnings.

videos.title: The 42nd Street Cavalry
videos.overview: McCloud's lackluster assignments make him grouse, so Chief Clifford sends him to the Mounted Unit. A fence sets up a munitions theft at a National Guard Armory (USMC) for a revolutionary group, and the cavalry is on its way.

videos.title: The Concrete Jungle Caper
videos.overview: The international drug trade and a dealer named Harry Hague have McCloud undercover and in prison to root out the Rhigas family of distributors.

videos.title: The Man with the Golden Hat
videos.overview: After hanging his Stetson in a diner one night, McCloud is stymied by various attempts to relieve him of it. His clues lead to a ballet company on the verge of folding, and a philanthropic foundation with millions of dollars missing from its account books.

videos.title: Lady on the Run
videos.overview: A woman pursues the hit man who killed her sister, and in Mexico City is pursued herself.

videos.title: Sharks!
videos.overview: Loan sharks accidentally kill a welcher, and a hardnosed Homicide lieutenant has the wrong man.

videos.title: Return to the Alamo
videos.overview: In the second "Alamo" episode, Phyllis Norton, in her last appearance, takes over the station when Chief Clifford catches the flu, a thief kidnaps Broadhurst in order to swap him for the thief's brother, a drug-addicted mother kidnaps her addicted newborn daughter - and a time bomb ticks in the squad room ceiling.

videos.title: Park Avenue Pirates
videos.overview: Racketeers take over a record company.

videos.title: Showdown at Times Square
videos.overview: The Chief (Clifford) is running a weekly bull session, that is, the detectives squawk and he gives them a talk. McCloud notices smoke signals coming from a nearby roof. The Chief (Stillwater) is seeking his grandson Johnny, who has followed a gang of thieves to New York. Johnny's father is in jail back home in Phoenix, framed by the gang.

videos.title: Fire!
videos.overview: Chris Coughlin's high-rise apartment building is torched by an arsonist for hire.

videos.title: Three Guns for New York
videos.overview: Paroled bank robbers from New Mexico think McCloud took off with their $400,000 twelve years before. They kidnap Chris Coughlin, shoot two FBI agents with McCloud's .45 Colt Frontier Six Shooter, and force him back to Taos after the money.

videos.title: Our Man in the Harem
videos.overview: A patrolman's daughter is held captive in the Middle East.

videos.title: The Day New York Turned Blue
videos.overview: During a New York City snowstorm, a union lawyer is placed in protective custody as a witness to graft, a working girl is slipping out-of-towners a mickey and painting them blue, a Federal Inspector is auditing the Department books, the mob plans an invasion of headquarters, and patrolmen have a strike meeting.

videos.title: Night of the Shark
videos.overview: The American mob plans an Australian expansion, with the help of a planted Chairman on Sydney's Police Board. McCloud, on airport duty at JFK, has a shootout with a hit man and goes to Sydney as a witness.

videos.title: Bonnie and McCloud
videos.overview: The head of a trucking company is killed before eyewitnesses, and McCloud's girlfriend is the culprit.

videos.title: 'Twas the Fight Before Christmas...
videos.overview: On Christmas Eve, an assassin stalks McCloud, a spurned mistress attempts suicide, a sidewalk Santa turns mugger, junkies raid a hospital pharmacy, Chris's newspaper organizes a party for orphans at Westside Hospital with Chief Clifford as Santa, and the junkies take hostages.

videos.title: The Great Taxicab Stampede
videos.overview: McCloud is framed for the murder of a drug-dealing hack, and exposes the ring.

videos.title: The Moscow Connection
videos.overview: The State Department sends Chief Clifford and McCloud to Moscow with a touring country & western singer, undercover.

videos.title: London Bridges
videos.overview: A peer of the realm, who's a photographer as well as a cat burglar, comes to America and, in flagrante delicto at a Long Island costume party, witnesses a killing at the hands of Irish bombers, all of which sends McCloud to Blighty, where the target remains to be found.

videos.title: McCloud Meets Dracula
videos.overview: Murder victims are found to be drained of blood, and an elderly star of vampire films is suspected; Chief Clifford is on the hunt for a random sniper.

awards: Nominated for 6 Primetime Emmys. 1 win & 10 nominations total
